capabilities: Write invoices as Markdown notes with frontmatter metadata, a line-item table, and an invoice code block
Calculate consumption tax per rate (10% / 8% reduced / exempt) with configurable rounding
Compute withholding tax and payment due dates from payment terms
Validate registration number format and corporate-number check digits
Render a print-ready invoice for PDF export
extras: README includes a disclaimer that calculations are not tax advice and that rates and thresholds can be adjusted in settings; works offline with no external services or telemetry.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to write qualified Japanese invoices with correct per-rate tax arithmetic and print-ready output.
summary: Markdown-based Japanese invoice (適格請求書) writer that calculates consumption tax, withholding tax and due dates, and renders a printable invoice.
